description: Test PYQ set containing 5 Computer Science questions.

questions.questionText: Which data structure follows the LIFO principle?
questions.explanation: Stack follows the LIFO (Last In, First Out) principle.

questions.questionText: Which protocol is primarily used to send e-mails?
questions.explanation: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is used for sending e-mails.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not an operating system?
questions.explanation: Oracle is primarily a database management system, while Linux, Windows and Android are operating systems.

questions.questionText: What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?
questions.explanation: Binary search repeatedly divides the search space into half, giving a time complexity of O(log n).

questions.questionText: Which language is mainly used to style web pages?
questions.explanation: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to control the presentation and styling of web pages.
